title: Podcast worker fatal NDJSON record
description: The last stderr/stdout line a managed podcast worker prints on a fatal exit (tools/podcast-transcriber/scripts/transcribe_task.py). The host parses type/errorCode/message/retryAfterSeconds/requiredAction field-by-field in control.rs (worker_error_code / worker_retry_after_seconds / worker_required_action / worker_error_message); type/errorCode/message are mandatory, the rest optional. Unknown keys are tolerated by the host, so this schema does not forbid them.

errorCode.description: TaskErrorCode wire name (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE). Codes outside this enum cannot be represented in TaskSnapshot.errorCode and degrade to UNKNOWN on the host.

requiredAction.description: RequiredAction wire name; the host maps it verbatim via control.rs::worker_required_action.
